The diff changes the condition from `if (unlikely(!hdr->segments_left))` to `if (unlikely(!hdr->segments_left || skb_headroom(skb) < chdr_len + skb->mac_len))`, directly addressing the missing headroom check.

    ipv6: rpl: Fix Route of Death.
